The Flaxx difference

Confidence should come from what can be shown.

Hair shopping asks people to make expensive decisions from inconsistent labels, polished images, and promises that are hard to test. Flaxx is being built differently.

We connect every permitted claim to a controlled record, explain what the evidence does—and does not—prove, and keep responsibility after delivery.

Layer 1 · working offer

Fit first. Then decide.

A proposed physical evidence-and-measurement kit designed to give you a useful result even if you never buy a full unit.

What the kit is meant to include

  • Soft measuring tape and six-measurement map
  • Approved lace samples
  • Actual or clearly labelled representative hair swatch
  • Evidence and limitation card
  • Guided fit result and next step

Validation price

$19 CAD delivered

Working hypothesis only. It proceeds when quotations, a ten-kit packing test, comprehension, willingness to pay, postage, remedy, and positive contribution pass.

What a sample cannot prove

Full construction

A swatch does not prove cap comfort or closure workmanship.

Wear life

A short sample cannot establish long-term behaviour.

Batch consistency

Representative material does not release a commercial batch.

How Flaxx verifies

Evidence before adjectives.

“Premium,” “raw,” “ethical,” and “best” are not evidence. Flaxx is being built to show what supports a claim, what that support covers, and where its limits begin.

1

Form the specification

Define what the provision must be before asking a supplier to describe it.

2

Qualify the source and rights

Confirm identity, authority, origin evidence, capability, change control, private-label rights, and remedies.

3

Compare development samples

Use the same questions and acceptance method across candidate sources.

4

Inspect, quarantine, and release

Risk-reduction inspection does not replace the final Flaxx release decision.

5

Keep responsibility after arrival

Record mismatch, investigate, communicate, and perform the approved remedy.

Long-horizon provision

Grow with the standard.
